description: Capture or restore an MHTML snapshot. Best for offline archival, replay testing, and compliance audits.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative file path to save/load the .mhtml snapshot (default: auto-generated in snapshots directory for capture).

hideOverlay.description: If false, keeps the Weavetab HUD and overlay visible in snapshot. Default true.

name: browser_snapshot
